	<div className="chorus-home-copy">
		<div className="hip-home-eyebrow">CHORUS</div>

		# A secure environment for research and AI on sensitive data

		<p className="hip-home-lead">CHORUS is an open-source Trusted Research Environment for biomedical research and AI. It brings computation, tools, and people to the data - so sensitive data can be analyzed without ever leaving the protected environment.</p>

		<div className="hip-home-cta">
			<a className="hip-home-btn hip-home-btn-primary" href="/docs/overview/what-is-chorus">What is CHORUS <span>→</span></a>
			<a className="hip-home-btn hip-home-btn-ghost" href="#documentation">Browse the documentation</a>
		</div>
	</div>
</section>
